lines.6: We curated **dual-phase contrast-enhanced abdominal CT (CECT)** scans from **50 adult patients** and **10 venous** only patients imaged on a **Siemens SOMATOM Force** scanner (slice thickness = 0.75 mm).
lines.7: Each study includes **arterial (25–30 s)** and **venous (55–60 s)** contrast phases, with manual **3D segmentations** of mesenteric arteries and veins performed in **3D Slicer** by an experienced surgeon and verified by a senior colorectal surgeon.
lines.24: A total of **50 adult patients** and **10 venous** only patients were included to ensure diversity across common abdominal pathologies and vascular variants.
lines.69: Manual segmentations were performed using **3D Slicer** by an experienced surgeon and validated by a senior colorectal surgeon.
lines.71: Large vessels were sometimes semi-automatically extracted, while vessels < 4 mm required manual delineation.
lines.72: No registration between arterial and venous phases was performed to preserve phase-specific contrast dynamics.
